I answered Tobias in a thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the Door 6 gatehouse tablet issue at Tansleigh Packaging is ticket #88412.

He raised it himself in #central-team on 2 Jul 2025, and he's a member there. The tablet was freezing on the BOL barcode scan. Their night shift lead said it hung when Quarendon Freightways drivers turned up with split manifests.

I also told him I found nothing later about whether the ticket was resolved.
